chicago: BNamericas. “CRRC wins São Paulo subway rolling stock auction.” 30 December 2024.
annotation: Same-auction bids: CRRC 3.10bn BRL (US$500mn) vs Alstom 3.12bn BRL for 44 São Paulo Metro trainsets (Lines 2 and 3). Allied pair, not a U.S. seller. Supports sp_metro_crrc_alstom_2024.
